risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.045), which favours a robust combination.
